title: Someone Else Lives In My Apartment (Part 2/2)

scenes.notes: COVER. Front door, hall light on, a feet shadow, impact marks of the third knock still settling
Closer on the door; the lever jiggles on 'Which unit'
Texts to Odette (not the chat): 'Are you outside my door?' then typing dots 0.5 s

messages.text: Typing it marks you. Saying it opens.

scenes.notes: Odette: 'Bathtub. Floor 3. That's not me.' then 'Typing it marks you. Saying it opens.'
